title: Complete versioned text-layer candidate with located and unlocated original lines

sourceIdentity.sourceFileId: Unicode scalar string 1..200 codepoints; Python strip unchanged; no controls; no aliases

x-semantic-contract.portableCanonical: Exact JSON data only; Unicode scalars, ASCII/codepoint key order, ensure_ascii false, compact separators; safe integers only; no floating JSON numbers. Native decimal values are strings. TS descriptor-first/proxy rejection; Python exact builtins; validate before hashing.

sourcePath.shape: Old top-level profile: [topLayoutIndex,lineChildIndex] for immediate original LTTextLine; [topLayoutIndex] only original LTTextLine or original text-container leaf. Analyzed-figures profile: complete native child-index ancestry from LTPage to each original whole LTTextLine or supported original text-container leaf after pinned pdfminer Form analysis; no synthetic joins.
sourcePath.indices: nonnegative safe integers <=32767; exact original enumeration BEFORE filtering/sorting
sourcePath.ordering: each output array lexicographic numeric sourcePath order, shorter prefix first
sourcePath.uniqueness: no duplicate or prefix-overlapping sourcePath anywhere in the same page across BOTH arrays
sourcePath.claim: one visited wholly-contained original line/leaf produces exactly one record; no glyph joins or synthetic line regrouping; arrays do not certify unseen PDF operators
sourcePath.profileLengths: Old top-level profile accepts only path lengths1..2; analyzed-figures profile accepts1..64. Every index is original enumeration after selected pinned library layout analysis and BEFORE filtering/sorting. Explicit boxes-flow-none profile accepts1..64 from its own selected native layout; historical profile paths are not migrated or reinterpreted. Explicit boxes-flow-none-vertical profile independently accepts1..64 from its own native vertical-writing-aware layout; its paths never replace old committed paths.

x-semantic-contract.rawText: Exact original get_text() including all original LF/separators/trailing whitespace; nonempty Unicode scalar string <=2000000 codepoints. Never strip, normalize, concatenate separate original lines, or publish a second semantic text field. LTAnno retained verbatim; its absence of geometry is not an invalid glyph.

nativeDecimalStrings.valueConstraints: finite exact decimal, abs<=1000000000; explicit exponent if present in [-324,308]; negative zero accepted; producer uses repr(float(native value)) with lowercase e
nativeDecimalStrings.order: native x0<=x1 and y0<=y1, never swap inverted edges
nativeDecimalStrings.validation: no epsilon used for native positive vs zero classification

geometry.quantization: Parse native repr decimal strings exactly (Decimal/rational); round-half-even(edge delta*1000) for every edge and dimension. No binary-float arithmetic in v3 quantization; v2 float-round unchanged.
geometry.frameDimensions: width=roundHalfEven((frame.x1-frame.x0)*1000), height analogous; both positive safe integers; reject collapsed/unsafe native frame
geometry.crop: A whole original line native box must be within visible frame with inclusive exact-decimal epsilon 0.000001 point. Wholly outside or partially crossing this containment policy is excluded exactly as legacy visible CropBox policy. Clamp already-contained rounding edges into [0,width/height]. No clipping text to manufacture an in-frame statement. No claim all off-crop raw retained.
geometry.located: native line strictly positive and quantized bbox x0<x1,y0<y1; all safe integer edges in page frame
geometry.NATIVE_ZERO_AREA: native width==0 OR native height==0; original whole line retained unlocated; no located bbox key
geometry.MILLI_POINT_COLLAPSE: native strictly positive; exact quantization/clamp produces x0==x1 OR y0==y1; unlocated native strings must independently prove this reason
geometry.invalid: nonfinite/inverted native boxes; zero parent containing positive child; positive whole line with any native zero-area LTChar; inconsistent glyph/line native positivity => whole extraction ValueError(INVALID_NATIVE_TEXT_GEOMETRY). No glyph millipoint-area gate, no deletion/splicing of invisible glyph.
geometry.unsupported: Bounded traversal of nontext layout containers detects visible/intersecting LTChar/LTTextLine/text container outside supported immediate whole-line traversal => whole extraction ValueError(UNSUPPORTED_TEXT_LAYOUT). Pure image/vector primitives ignored; nested Form glyphs are NOT grouped into invented lines. Entirely offcrop unsupported text can be excluded.

qualityRules.metrics: Recompute from exact rawText across both arrays. No host Unicode category/alphanumeric/isalnum matching.
qualityRules.nonWhitespace: count Unicode scalar codepoints outside above fixed whitespace set in each array
qualityRules.disallowedControls: count U+0000..001F except U+0009/U+000A/U+000D, and U+007F..009F, in both arrays (even if whitespace); fixed Cc ranges, no host category APIs
qualityRules.reasons: NO_LOCATED_TEXT iff locatedNonWhitespaceCharacters==0; TEXT_DECODING_ANOMALY iff replacementCharacters>0 OR disallowedControlCharacters>0 OR cidPlaceholders>0; UNLOCATED_TEXT_PRESENT iff unlocatedLineCount>0; exact reasonOrder
qualityRules.disposition: OCR_REQUIRED if NO_LOCATED_TEXT or TEXT_DECODING_ANOMALY; otherwise PARTIAL_TEXT_LAYER if UNLOCATED_TEXT_PRESENT; otherwise TEXT_LAYER_CANDIDATE. Punctuation-only can be CANDIDATE; this is no readability, semantic, geometric completeness or confidence certificate.
qualityRules.counts: summary sums page dispositions; locatedTextPageCount counts page with locatedNonWhitespaceCharacters>0; unlocatedTextPageCount counts page with unlocatedLineCount>0; pages all contiguous1..N
qualityRules.cidPlaceholders: Count nonoverlapping ASCII \(cid:[0-9]+\) matches within each individual whole rawText, summed across both arrays; no cross-line concatenation

limits.scope: one whole artifact, including every page and both record arrays; reject never truncate

x-semantic-contract.readerSafety: VALID requires whole artifact native/schema/geometry/reason/profilehash/quality validation. It returns no v2 block facade. Future source consumers must explicitly accept v3 and treat relevant unlocated lines or unlocated competing full-page anchors as abstention. Source authority, measurement unit, identity and confidence never inferred.
x-semantic-contract.legacyPreservation: All v1/v2 artifacts/readers/profiles and T59 text_layer.py bytes unchanged. Historical/default v3 top-level behavior and old manuals unchanged. New analyzed-figures profile is explicit opt-in; old v3 readers may reject this new policy. No implicit v2 coercion or release activation in T60/T61.

traversalProfiles.pdfminer-top-level-whole-lines-v1: Historical/default producer behavior unchanged; do not call Form analysis. Visible unsupported nested primitives cause UNSUPPORTED_TEXT_LAYOUT.
traversalProfiles.pdfminer-analyzed-figures-whole-lines-v1: Explicit opt-in only. Preflight native figure topology before recursive library analysis: page depth0, maximum native depth64, at most200000 native objects per page across analyzed figure subtrees; fail INPUT_LIMIT, never RecursionError/truncate. Call pinned pdfminer LTFigure.analyze(LAParams(all_texts=True)) exactly once on each outermost figure, never re-analyze page or descendants. Enumerate original analyzed subtrees without manual glyph grouping. Full native paths1..64. Ignore image/vector-only primitives. Same invalid-glyph, visible CropBox, raw, decimal geometry and quality policies. LTFigure bbox is not renderer clipping authority; no visibility/occlusion/completeness certificate.
traversalProfiles.pdfminer-analyzed-figures-boxes-flow-non: Explicit opt-in only. Initial page analysis uses pinned pdfminer LAParams(boxes_flow=None, all_texts=False); existing visible CropBox/CTM and vector suppression remain identical. Preflight native figure topology with the existing depth64 and200000 figure-object limits, then invoke each outermost LTFigure.analyze(LAParams(boxes_flow=None, all_texts=True)) once. Library groups original glyphs into whole lines/textboxes as before, but disables id(object)-tied hierarchical textbox grouping. Pinned library stable textbox ordering is used directly, including stable input order for geometric ties; never reorder/rename committed native paths. Full ancestry1..64 before filtering, rawText/native geometry/quality/visibility limits unchanged. No guarantee of semantic reading order, renderer visibility or completeness.

Explicit opt-in only, default and historical three profiles unchanged. Initial page analysis uses pinned pdfminer20260107 LAParams(boxes_flow=None, all_texts=False, detect_vertical=True); visible CropBox/actual interpreter CTM and vector suppression identical to old stable mode. Before recursive library analysis preflight original topology: page depth0, depth maximum64 and total at most200000 native objects per page across outermost figure subtrees. Fail INPUT_LIMIT before analyze, never truncate. Invoke each outermost LTFigure.analyze(LAParams(boxes_flow=None, all_texts=True, detect_vertical=True)) once; descendants analyzed only by pinned library recursion. Enumerate exact resulting native children before filtering, maximum path64/index32767. Whole original LTTextLine.get_text() retained including LF and library child order; no manual glyph join/reversal, sorting or native-path renaming. Vertical-writing grouping is a source text heuristic, not numeric/unit/rectangle/area/member/applicability/rendered visibility authority. Same whole artifact standard/large resource policies, invalid-glyph/quantization/visible containment/quality rules. No durable audit/cache/default/profile release activation by this extension.
